result.title: MSCR: Jointly Balancing Utilization Across Modalities and Discovering Synergistic Information
result.summary: In multimodal learning, modality imbalance often lets one modality dominate optimization and keeps the model from fully exploiting cross-modal interactions. Balance-oriented methods such as the Multimodal Competition Regularizer (MCR) perform well by alleviating this imbalance during training. These dynamic balancing methods, however, mainly adjust modality contributions and do not consider how imbalance affects the formation of synergistic information during fusion. Synergy is a major source of multimodal advantage, because it is predictive gain that cannot be recovered from unimodal evidence alone. We propose the Multimodal Synergistic Competition Regularizer (MSCR), a fusion method that jointly promotes balanced modality utilization and the discovery of synergistic information. MSCR has two complementary objectives. An anti-dominance objective suppresses excessive unimodal influence and leaves room for synergistic information, and a synergy objective encourages the fused predictor to outperform a non-synergistic unimodal reference. An adaptive gate further concentrates the regularization on samples that need stronger collaborative modeling. Experiments on five benchmarks show that MSCR consistently improves performance over MCR and strengthens synergistic capability. It raises conditional recovery, the accuracy of the fused prediction on samples that the unimodal predictors misclassify, as well as the share of the model's output that InterSHAP attributes to cross-modal interactions. Its gain in conditional recovery persists when the fusion module is Transformer-based. Code is available at https://github.com/chenxinyu991-collab/MSCR.

AI.brief_summary: 针对多模态学习中模态不平衡削弱协同信息的问题，提出融合方法 MSCR，用「抗主导」目标与「协同」目标配合自适应门控，联合促进模态均衡利用与协同信息发现，在五个基准上优于 MCR。
AI.relevance_reason: 其抑制单一模态过度影响的训练正则、以及以融合预测优于单模态参照来度量协同增益（并用 InterSHAP 归因）的思路，可能可供核查 VLM 推理中文本先验主导与视觉旁路问题，以及视觉证据贡献的监督与评价设计。
